echaron: echar — they cast, laid (preterite 3rd pl.; delant le echaron las cartas 'they laid the letters before him'; = echaron)
paga: pagar — is pleased, is satisfied (present 3rd sg., reflexive se paga; de coraçón se paga 'is heartily pleased'; = se paga, se alegra)
saludadme: saludar — greet (imperative 2nd pl. + dative me 'for me, on my behalf'; saludadme a mio Çid 'give my greetings to mio Çid for me'; = saludad de mi parte)
preçiada: preçiar — prized, valued, precious (past part. as adjective, fem. sg.; tanta mula preçiada 'so many a prized mule'; = preciada)
palafré: palafré — palfrey, a riding horse for the road, not the warhorse (= palafrén)
astas: asta — shaft, staff of a lance or banner (fem. pl.; meter en astas 'to set on shafts', i.e. to mount banners; = astas)
boclados: boclado — bossed, fitted with a boss (past part. as adjective, masc. pl.; Pidal: boclados con oro 'con bloca de oro', with a boss of gold; escudos boclados 'bossed shields'; = blocados, guarnecidos con bloca)
andriandria: Andriandria — Andros, the Aegean island famed for its sendals (token of A[n]dria[n]dria, the two n's Pidal's; following Crescini, Pidal reads the manuscript's Adria as Andria, a medieval name of Andros, and gives up his earlier A[lexán]dria; the doubled form is unexplained, perhaps a misprint; çendales d' Andriandria 'sendals of Andros')
conduchos: conducho — provisions, victuals (masc. pl.; conduchos largos 'abundant provisions'; = víveres, provisiones)
aparejadas: aparejar — made ready, prepared (past part. as predicate, fem. pl.; las vistas son aparejadas 'the meeting is prepared'; = aparejadas, preparadas)
atantas: atanto — so many (fem. pl.; tanto with a- prefixed; atantas buenas conpañas 'so many good companies'; = tantas)
adebdan: adebdar — they run into debt, buy on credit (present 3rd pl.; from debda 'debt'; lo uno adebdan e lo otro pagavan 'some they bought on credit and some they paid for'; = adeudan, se endeudan)
creçer: creçer — to grow, increase (infinitive, first half of a split conditional; creçer les ya la ganançia 'would grow for them'; = crecer)
quisiessen: querer — they might wish, would wish (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; quantos quisiessen averes 'as many as might want goods'; = quisiesen)
cuemdes: cuemde — count (noble title; masc. pl., old form of conde spelled with m; in cue[mdes] the mdes is Pidal's; = condes)
podestades: podestad — magnate, lord holding an office below count (fem. noun in pl., used of people; Pidal: ricos omnes holding the government or tenure of a fortress, city or territory; = potestades)
leoneses: leonés — man of León, Leonese (masc. pl.; = leoneses)
gallizianas: galliziano — Galician (fem. pl., agreeing with mesnadas; mesnadas gallizianas 'Galician troops'; = gallegas)
castellanas: castellano — Castilian (fem. pl., used as a noun, mesnadas understood; las castellanas 'the Castilian ones'; = castellanas)
adeliñadas: adeliñar — heading straight, set on their way (past part. as predicate, fem. pl., agreeing with the mesnadas; a las vistas se van adeliñadas 'they go straight to the meeting'; = encaminadas, derechas)
detarda: detardar — he delays (present 3rd sg.; non lo detarda 'he does not delay it'; = tarda)
adobó: adobar — he prepared himself, got ready (preterite 3rd sg., reflexive se adobó; = se aderezó, se preparó)
gruessa: gruesso — big, sturdy, heavy-built (fem. sg.; tanta gruessa mula 'so many a stout mule'; = gruesa)
sazón: sazón — due season, prime condition; de sazón 'in good condition, fit' (palafré de sazón 'a palfrey in prime condition', probably; = sazón)
arma: arma — arm, weapon, armor (fem. sg. as collective; tanta buena arma 'so much good armor'; = arma)
colores: color — colour (pl.; vestidos son de colores 'are dressed in colours', i.e. in bright, fine cloth; = colores)
á: á — to, at (Pidal's accented spelling of the preposition a; mandó á Mont Mayor 'he held Montemayor'; = a)
galind: Galind — personal name (Galind Garçiaz, the Cid's knight from Aragon, Galín Garciaz elsewhere; = Galindo)
garçiaz: Garçiaz — patronymic 'son of García' (Galind Garçiaz; spelling with ç beside garciaz; = Garcés)
adoban: adobar — they prepare themselves, get ready (present 3rd pl., reflexive se adoban; se adoban por ir 'they get ready to go'; = se aderezan)
curien: curiar — (that) they guard, look after (present subjunctive 3rd pl. after mandó que; que curien a Valencia 'that they guard Valencia'; = cuiden, guarden)
corazón: corazón — heart (spelling variant of coraçón; d' alma e de corazón 'with soul and heart', i.e. with all their might; = corazón)
dessos: de + essos — of, under those (preposition de + demonstrative essos masc. pl.; en poder dessos 'in the power of those'; = de esos)
recabdado: recabdar — arranged, secured, taken care of (past part. in the perfect recabdado ha; = ha recaudado, ha dispuesto)
puode: poder — can (present 3rd sg., with the old diphthong uo, the o Pidal's in pu[o]de; una salir non puode 'not one (woman) can go out', Pidal 'que ninguna puede salir'; = puede)
torne: tornar — (until) he return (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; fata ques torne 'until he returns'; = vuelva)
salien: salir — they were leaving, came out (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ién; Salien de Valençia 'they were leaving Valencia'; = salían)
aguijan: aguijar — they spur on, hasten (present 3rd pl.; = aguijan, espolean)
gañara: gañar — he had won (pluperfect indicative in -ra; se los gañara 'he had won them for himself'; = ganar; se los había ganado)
ge: ge — to him, to her, to them (old dative pronoun before lo, la, los, las, where modern Spanish has se; non ge los dieran en don 'they had not given them to him as a gift'; = se)
hyas: hyas — hya + se, now … off (hya = ya with h-, + reflexive se glued on; Hyas va 'now he goes off'; = ya se)
paró: parar — he agreed, arranged (preterite 3rd sg.; Pidal: 'convino, concertó'; las vistas que con el rey paró 'the meeting he arranged with the king'; = acordó, concertó)

__broaden__.s: se — himself, themselves (reflexive pronoun cut to s’ before a vowel; juntados s’[a]n = se han juntado 'they have gathered'; = se) · also s' = si 'if' (s' yo bivo so 'if I am alive'; = si)
__broaden__.ques: que + se — who ... themselves (que, relative pronoun, + reflexive se; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who managed to escape'; = los que se pudieron escapar) · also ques — qué + se, 'what … to' (interrogative que + se; non sabent ques far 'they know not what to do', as qué se far at v. 1155; no note in Pidal; = qué hacer) · also fata ques torne 'until he returns' (conjunction fata que + reflexive se; = hasta que se vuelva)
__broaden__.tanto: tanto — so much, so great · tanto quanto + subjunctive 'as long as' (tanto quanto yo biva 'as long as I live') · also tanto — 'so many' before a masc. sg. noun used collectively (tanto palafré, tanto buen pendón 'so many a palfrey, so many a good banner'; = tantos)
__broaden__.uno: uno — one; en uno = 'together, as one' · el uno ... el otro 'the one ... the other' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró) · also lo uno … lo otro 'one part … the other part' (neuter; lo uno adebdan e lo otro pagavan 'part they owe and part they paid')
__broaden__.tenien: tener — they held; with armas, they played at arms (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ién; armas tenien 'they played at arms', Pidal 'jugaban las armas'; = tenían) · also tener 'hold, reckon' (commo ellos tenien 'as they reckoned it', imperfect 3rd pl.; = tenían, pensaban)
__broaden__.corredor: corredor — runner, fast horse (noun from correr; si serié corredor 'whether he would be a runner'; = corredor, closest caballo veloz) · also corredor — swift (adjective, masc. sg.; tanto buen cavallo corredor 'so many a good swift horse'; = veloz)
__broaden__.mejor: mejor — better, best (adverb; quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she knows how'; = mejor) · also mejor — better (adjective; oy es día bueno e mejor será cras 'today is a good day and tomorrow will be better') · also mejor — best (comparative as superlative, after the noun; coranado mejor 'the best churchman'; = el mejor)
__broaden__.dieran: dar — they had given (pluperfect in -ra; = habían dado) · also non ge los dieran en don 'they had not given them to him as a gift' (= no se los habían dado)
__broaden__.cuenta: cuenta — count, reckoning, account · also non son en cuenta 'they are not in the count': past counting, or not reckoned in (= no se cuentan)
